sets.title: Formation Types
sets.description: Identify word formation patterns and sort by type
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите способы словообразования и рассортируйте по типам

items.prompt: писать → переписать. What formation type is this?
items.promptEnglish: to write → to rewrite. What changed?
items.hint: A new element was added before the root.
items.explanation: пере- is a prefix added to писать. Prefixation changes meaning while keeping the same word class (verb → verb).

items.prompt: учить → учитель. What formation type is this?
items.hint: An element was added after the root, changing the word class.
items.explanation: The suffix -тель was added to create an agent noun. Suffixation often changes the part of speech (verb → noun).

items.prompt: пар + воз → паровоз. What formation type is this?
items.hint: Two separate roots were joined together.
items.explanation: Two roots (пар + воз) joined by the linking vowel -о- form a compound word: паровоз.

items.prompt: What does the prefix вы- typically mean?
items.hint: All these verbs involve movement outward.
items.explanation: вы- = out: выходить (go out), выписать (write out), выбросить (throw out).

items.prompt: What does the suffix -ник create?
items.hint: These words name people or objects.
items.explanation: -ник creates nouns for agents (работник = worker) or objects (учебник = textbook, чайник = teapot).

items.prompt: водопад: вод + о + пад. What links the two roots?
items.hint: Russian compounds use a special vowel between roots.
items.explanation: The linking vowel -о- (sometimes -е-) connects roots in compound words: вод-о-пад, пар-о-воз, сам-о-лёт.

items.prompt: читать → чтение. What does -ение/-ание create?
items.hint: This suffix turns a verb into a noun describing the action itself.
items.explanation: -ение/-ание creates verbal nouns: чтение (reading), учение (learning), написание (writing).

items.prompt: What does the prefix за- mean in запеть, заговорить, заплакать?
items.promptEnglish: to start singing, to start speaking, to start crying
items.hint: All three verbs describe the start of something.
items.explanation: за- with verbs of sound/emotion marks the beginning: запеть (burst into song), заговорить (start talking), заплакать (start crying).

items.prompt: землетрясение: земл + е + тряс + ение. How many formation processes are combined?
items.hint: Two roots were joined, AND a suffix was added.
items.explanation: землетрясение combines compounding (земл + тряс, linked by -е-) with suffixation (-ение). Complex words often layer multiple formation types.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these derived words by formation type

patternRecognition.question: What pattern unites all these words?
patternRecognition.explanation: All are agent nouns: the -тель suffix creates 'person who does X' from verbs (читать → читатель, строить → строитель).

patternRecognition.question: What formation process do these words share?
patternRecognition.explanation: All are compound words with two roots: сам+о+лёт, пар+о+ход, пар+о+воз, вод+о+пад, лед+о+кол.

patternRecognition.question: What holds this word family together?
patternRecognition.explanation: All share the root пис- (write) with different prefixes: на-, вы-, за-, пере-, под-. Each prefix shifts the meaning.

sets.title: Root Recognition
sets.description: Identify roots in derived and compound words
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите корни в производных и сложных словах

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Prefix changes meaning while the root stays the same
hints: на- often means completion or accumulation.
за- can mean behind, or the beginning/recording of an action.
под- means under or up to.
explanations: на- + писать = написать: the prefix adds the meaning of completion.
пере- + писать = переписать: re-write or copy over.
вы- + писать = выписать: write out, extract from a list or text.
за- + писать = записать: write down, record, note.
под- + писать = подписать: sign (write under), subscribe.

minimalPairs.context: Лена _____ рецепт из книги. (copied out a recipe from a book)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Lena wrote out a recipe from a book.
minimalPairs.explanation: выписать = write out, extract from a source. записать = write down, make a note. Extracting from a book = выписать.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The doctor issued her a referral.
minimalPairs.explanation: выписать also means to issue/prescribe (a document, prescription). записать = write down, record.

minimalPairs.context: Журналист _____ все факты в блокнот. (noted down all the facts)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The journalist wrote down all the facts in a notebook.
minimalPairs.explanation: записать = to write down, record. переписать = to rewrite or copy. Writing new notes = записать.

minimalPairs.context: Студент _____ сочинение заново. (rewrote the essay from scratch)
minimalPairs.explanation: переписать = to rewrite. подписать = to sign. Starting over = переписать.
подписать = to sign (literally 'write under'). написать = to write/compose. Putting a signature = подписать.

items.prompt: What is the shared root in: водопад, водовоз, подводный?
items.hint: All three words relate to water.
items.explanation: вод- is the root from вода (water): водо-пад (water-fall), водо-воз (water-carrier), под-вод-ный (under-water).

items.prompt: What is the shared root in: летать, самолёт, лётчик, вылет?
items.hint: All relate to flight.
items.explanation: лёт-/лет- (flight/fly) appears in all: само-лёт (self-flyer), лёт-чик (flyer/pilot), вы-лет (departure, lit. flying out).

items.prompt: What is the shared root in: учить, учитель, ученик, учебник, учение?
items.promptEnglish: to teach, teacher, student, textbook, learning
items.hint: All relate to teaching and learning.
items.explanation: уч- (teach/learn) is the root: уч-итель (teacher), уч-еник (student), уч-ебник (textbook), уч-ение (learning).

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Build sentences with derived words and translate word formation patterns
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения с производными словами и переведите

translation.english: The writer finished the novel last week.
translation.answer: Писатель закончил роман на прошлой неделе.
acceptableVariants: На прошлой неделе писатель закончил роман.
Писатель дописал роман на прошлой неделе.
translation.hint: Use the agent noun from писать + -тель.
Steam (пар) + goes (ход) = compound word for steamship.

translation.english: She signed the document without reading it.
translation.answer: Она подписала документ, не читая его.
acceptableVariants: Она подписала документ, не прочитав его.
Не читая документ, она его подписала.
На изучение новых слов нужно время.
translation.hint: Turn the verb изучать into a verbal noun with -ение.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Compound word formation with linking vowels
hints: earth + shake + action suffix, linked by -е-.
explanations: земл-е-тряс-ение: земля (earth) + трясти (to shake) + -ение = earthquake. Uses linking vowel -е-.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All word formation types mixed in varied exercises
sets.descriptionRussian: Все типы словообразования в разных упражнениях

items.prompt: ходить → вход, выход, переход, поход. These are all formed by:
items.hint: The verb root gets a prefix and becomes a noun without an added suffix.
items.explanation: в-ход, вы-ход, пере-ход, по-ход: prefix + root with no overt suffix (zero suffixation). This is a productive pattern for creating nouns from motion verbs.

items.prompt: Which word means 'earthquake'?
items.hint: Compound word + -ение action noun suffix.
items.explanation: земл-е-тряс-ение (earthquake): compound of земля + трясти with the action noun suffix -ение.

items.prompt: носить → переносить. What meaning does пере- add here?
items.hint: пере- often means 'across' or 'from one place to another.'
items.explanation: пере- adds the meaning of transfer or moving across: переносить (to carry over/transfer), also переехать (to move house).

items.prompt: Which is the correct agent noun from 'водить' (to drive)?
items.hint: The standard agent suffix for this verb is -тель.
items.explanation: водить + -тель = водитель (driver). Not every verb takes -тель (e.g., работать → работник with -ник), but водить does.

items.prompt: What type of compound is мореплаватель?
items.hint: море (sea) + плавать (to sail) + -тель (person who).
items.explanation: мор-е-плава-тель: compound (море + плавать) with linking vowel -е- and agent suffix -тель. Three formation processes in one word.

items.prompt: под- + писать = подписать. What does it mean?
items.hint: Literally 'to write under' (your name at the bottom).
items.explanation: под- (under) + писать (write) = подписать (to sign): literally placing your name underneath a document.

items.prompt: Which suffix creates feminine agent nouns from masculine -тель?
items.hint: учитель → учитель-ница, писатель → писатель-ница.
items.explanation: -ница is added to -тель nouns to form feminine equivalents: учительница (female teacher), писательница (female writer).

items.prompt: пылесос: пыль + сосать. What is this household object?
items.hint: A machine that sucks up dust.
items.explanation: пыл-е-сос: пыль (dust) + сосать (to suck) = vacuum cleaner. A compound noun with linking vowel -е-.

items.prompt: до- + писать = дописать. What does it mean?
items.hint: до- often means 'up to the end, to completion.'
items.explanation: до- + писать = дописать (to finish writing, write to the end). до- adds the meaning of completing an action.

minimalPairs.context: Алексей _____ все документы из офиса. (carried out, removed)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Alexey carried all the documents out of the office.
minimalPairs.explanation: вы-нести (carry out) vs. за-нести (bring in, carry in). Moving things OUT of the office = вынес.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The courier brought the package into the office.
minimalPairs.explanation: за-нести (carry in, bring) vs. вы-нести (carry out). Delivering INTO the office = занёс.
учитель (teacher, -тель = agent) vs. учебник (textbook, -ник = object). A person = учитель.
учебник (textbook, -ник = tool/object for learning) vs. учитель (teacher, -тель = person). A book = учебник.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ статью для журнала. (wrote, authored from scratch)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She wrote an article for the magazine.
minimalPairs.explanation: на-писать (write, complete a new text) vs. пере-писать (rewrite). Creating from scratch = написала.
